title: Derry map — three Derrys
brief: Bilingual interactive map page: one original map of Derry with an era switch (1962, 1988–89, 2016) that repaints the town and swaps its cited places (37: the 20 existing plus 17 new). Recurring places keep their spot and link to the same spot in other eras; each place lists the characters who pass through it, linked to their cards. Works without JS (radios, :target); reduced motion keeps it still; disclaimer visible.

artboards.title: Three Derrys
artboards.tradeoff: Clear map + list layout that works with keyboard, without JS and on phones, and shows continuity across eras; on phones the pins are small, so the list below is the main way in, and the map is schematic (no illustrated buildings) to keep 12–13 pins per era legible
